01Client feedback
Make sense of client feedback
You want the team to get better at understanding and categorizing the feedback clients send.
Themes you can act on
Feedback grouped into themes, with counts and real client quotes, so the team knows what matters most and can show why.
02Influence
Win decisions with stakeholders
You want the team to have more influence when decisions are made with stakeholders.
A case stakeholders say yes to
Each proposal comes with a checked metric, a clear tradeoff, and a plan for getting alignment before the meeting.
03Workflow
Work and process efficiency
The team uses Claude for PRDs and user stories, and wants its workflows and processes to run more efficiently.
Claude helps with more of the work
Claude also sorts feedback, checks metrics, turns a brief into a prototype, and runs recurring tasks on a schedule.

ASuggested: bring your own work
Every course ends with an artifact. Make it yours.
  • Client feedback. Run the feedback lab on a real export of client comments, within your data rules.
  • A live decision. Build the next stakeholder proposal with the evidence and metric from class.
  • One workflow. Pick one weekly task, such as a status update, and save it as a workflow.
